title: GM reaches $220M settlement over selling drivers' private data | TechCrunch
summary: Data brokers sold this information to insurance providers, which could affect customers’ rates, the NYT reported at the time. However, customers who opt not to share their data will likely have limited access to certain features, according to GM.
